Name: Mr BeatLoop
Overview:
Create music quickly on your Xbox 360. Best viewed as a fun music/sketch toy, Mr BeatLoop lets you create loops using 3 different drum kits and 8 different instruments.

Edit the loops in real time, change the speed, save and load your best ideas!

Designed with absolute ease of use and fun in mind - Mr BeatLoop is great for sketching up quick musical ideas, or just experimenting!
